keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Jordan Zemura (Watford) is shown the yellow card.
Hayden Carter (Blackburn Rovers) is shown the yellow card.
Moussa Baradji (Blackburn Rovers) is shown the yellow card.
Penalty saved. Iker Bravo (Watford) right footed shot saved in the bottom left corner by Aynsley Pears (Blackburn Rovers).
First Half ends, Watford 0, Blackburn Rovers 0.
Second Half begins Watford 0, Blackburn Rovers 0.
Delay in match because of an injury Edoardo Bove (Watford).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Delay in match because of an injury Edoardo Bove (Watford).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Watford. Edo Kayembe replaces Edoardo Bove because of an injury.
Mattie Pollock (Watford) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Watford 0, Blackburn Rovers 1. Todd Cantwell (Blackburn Rovers) converts the penalty with a right footed shot to the top left corner.
Second yellow card to Jordan Zemura (Watford).
Substitution, Watford. Branimir Mlacic replaces Soumaïla Coulibaly.
Substitution, Watford. Othmane Maamma replaces Amin Nabizada.
Substitution, Watford. Marc Bola replaces Stephy Mavididi.
Kristi Montgomery (Blackburn Rovers) is shown the yellow card.
Substitution, Blackburn Rovers. Augustus Kargbo replaces Oladapo Afolayan.
Substitution, Blackburn Rovers. Yuki Ohashi replaces Andri Gudjohnsen.
Substitution, Blackburn Rovers. Ryoya Morishita replaces Jayden Fevrier.
Substitution, Watford. Rocco Vata replaces Iker Bravo.
Substitution, Blackburn Rovers. Yuri Ribeiro replaces Harry Pickering.
Substitution, Blackburn Rovers. Jake Garrett replaces Todd Cantwell.
Second Half ends, Watford 0, Blackburn Rovers 1.
